title: ContinuityError - A Collaborative Story Telling Game
author: SevynTech
selftext:
Continuity Error is a free browser game where everyone gets the same story so far and a few minutes to write the next sentence. Then you all vote, anonymously, on which one makes the cut. The winning sentence joins the story, the rest are lost to history, and by round four your noir detective is somehow a sentient lasagna running for mayor. Nobody is responsible. Everybody is responsible.



There are three ways to play. Real Time Games are the party mode: 3 to 20 players, timed rounds, no account needed, just send your friends the link. Long Term Games are the same thing in slow motion, with notifications when it's your turn, for groups who can't all be awake at once. And then there's the Perpetual Story: one never-ending story the whole site adds to, one sentence per person per round, forever. It has no plot. It has no end. It is perpetual.



I am not a programmer but always thought this would be a cool game. I built it with a lot of help from Claude so please be gentle with it. It's free, there are no ads, and it works on your phone. Come make a story with me: [https://continuityerror.party](https://continuityerror.party)



All feedback is welcome. Enjoy!
